text: Followed 'Open ground lies about 180 to the north' from (12,225); after sprinting ~190 units north F now says 'Too close to the Camp of Easternland: 91 away... Open ground lies about 160 to the east'. The first hint pointed into another settlement's 250-unit exclusion zone. No compass/minimap on screen to know which way is north either.

Inside own settlement: a huge white floating label '0 here, 2/8 residents' is drawn behind/over the top HUD panels and chronicle, cut off at the top of the screen. Also 'Send Caravan (Town era)' is shown greyed: caravans are locked until Town era.

GOOD: inside own settlement with 3/8 residents present, Market Info shows 0/4 stalls and objective 6 'Build a market stall' still open: residents did not fill my market. Minor layout: Market Info panel runs down into the Season panel (Season shows only one line).

Pressed B inside Southtown with 22 wood/5 stone: 'Stall built.', objective 6 completed at tick 6900 from MY stall (Oscar Smith's stall in rival Blackfield at tick 6800 did not count). Market now 1/4 stalls with 'Merchants: Nancy Walker' - a resident immediately staffs the stall I built. Layout bugs on this frame: Inventory Info panel jumped to screen centre over the well, and the objective 7 progress bar text is clipped on the left ('nbers 3/10 - Buildings 0/2').

Sell Resources right after building my stall: 'No merchant here can pay: the richest has 0 coins, and your cheapest good (sapling) sells for 19.' Clear message, but the only merchant is the brand-new one with 0 coins, so selling at my own new market is impossible at first. Also sells saplings first as 'cheapest good' - unexpected.

~8 game s later both Sell Resources and Purchase Food still fail at my own 1-stall market (merchant 0 coins, no stock), while Market Info lists live buy/sell prices for 9 goods with trend arrows - looks tradable but nothing can be traded. Inventory Info panel remains displaced to screen centre.
